_commentary: One directory per example: input/ plus this file. tags name what the example exercises — dimensionality, physics module, boundary type, solver — because coverage across tags is what a set of examples buys; ten examples on the same code path cost ten times as much as one for none of the benefit. cpu_baseline_seconds is the incumbent's runtime on the CONTRIBUTOR'S machine — context for choosing examples (too short to show acceleration, or too long to grade, gets excluded or rescaled), never the speedup denominator; the official baseline is timed by the operator. contributor signs the example: any user of the code may add one from their own production runs — the code owner is not required. Delete this key.
